a: ပကမ္ပတိ(ကြိ)

H: pakampati：[pa-kampati＜kamp] 震，發抖哆嗦，震動．aor．pakampi； caus．pakampeti．
S: pakampati：[pa-kampati＜kamp] 震う，ふるえる，振動す．aor．pakampi； caus．pakampeti．
D: Pakampati，（pa + kamp + a），战栗，震动。 【过】 ~mpi。 【过分】 ~mpita。【动名】 ~mpana。（p184）

K:

DOP: pakampati pr. 3 sg. [ S. prakampate], shakes, quakes, trembles; Ap 158, 15 (yasmiṃ ca jāyamānasmiṃ dasasahassī ~ati, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be kampati); Bv 2:91 (dasasahassī ~ati); — part.pr. pakampamāna, mfn. , Pv-a 199, 6 ; — aor. 3 sg. ( a ) pakampi, Ja II 135, 10 (gāmabhojako bhīto ~i); Paṭis-a 613, 32 ; ( b ) pakampatha, Ap 100, 4 (dasasahassī ~atha, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se kampatha); 147, 4 (vasudhā ’yaṃ ~atha); Bv 1:71 (chappakāraṃ ~atha); Cp 1:9:58 (sattakkhattuṃ ~atha, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se akampatha); ( c ) pakampittha, Ap 151, 25 (bhavanaṃ pi ~ittha); 411, 19 (sabbākāraṃ ~ittha kevalā vasudhā ayaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee chabbikāraṃ; Se chappakāram akampittha); 411, 22 ; 3 pl. pakampiṃsu, Dāṭh 1:40; — caus. pr. 3 sg. pakampeti, ~ayati, 1. shakes (intrans.), trembles; Ja VI 295, 9* (vaṃso vāpi ~aye, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce pakampiyo; 295, 14´ foll.: yathā vaṃsagumbato uggatavaṃso vātena pahaṭakāle kampati evaṃ raññā kathitakāle kampeyya; cf Mil 372, 23* : vaṃso va anulomayaṃ); — 2. shakes (trans.), makes tremble; Ap 18, 16 (paṭhaviṃ te ~enti) quoted Ap-a 221, 24* ( Be, Ee, Se so; Ce pakappenti; 221, 28 : ākāse pi udake pi paṭhaviṃ nimminitvā iriyāpathaṃ ~entī ti attho, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce pakappentī ti); Ap 426, 29 (chabbikāraṃ ~enti, Ee so; Be, Ce chappakāraṃ; Se chabbikāraṃ pakāsenti); — part.pr. pakampayanta, mfn. , Dāṭh 1:38; — aor. 2 sg. pakampayi, Ap 505, 13 (yadābhijāto paṭhaviṃ ~ayi, Ce so; Be paṭhavī ~ayī; Ee paṭhavī ~asi; Se paṭhavī ~ayi); — pakampayeyyuṃ in Ee S I 107, 5 is prob. wr for pakappayeyyuṃ ( Be, Ce, Ee ); — pp pakampita , mfn. , shaken, trembling; S I 133, 19* (sabbo loko ~o) = Thī 200; — see also appakampi(n).
